ios.desc:
TimeCalc – The Simple and Accurate Time Calculator

Need to add, subtract or compare times?
TimeCalc makes it easy to calculate hours, minutes, and seconds perfect for logging flight hours, tracking work shifts, or planning projects.

With a clean interface and powerful tools, you can:
- Perform operations on hours, minutes, and seconds (add, subtract, multiply, divide)
- Calculate the difference between two dates or times
- Add or subtract time from a specific date
- Convert results into years, days, hours, minutes, or seconds
- Convert between decimal hours and HH:MM:SS format
- Save and share important calculations
- Sync operations with iCloud across iPhone, iPad, and Mac

Why TimeCalc
No more guessing or manual math. TimeCalc is trusted by pilots, professionals, and anyone who works with time on a daily basis.

TimeCalc Pro – Free Trial Included

Unlock the full power of TimeCalc with a 3-day free trial:
- Unlimited time operations
- Save and export results
- iCloud sync across all devices
- Beautiful ad-free experience

Choose between weekly or annual subscription plans. Cancel anytime.

By the way, AppStore reviews are very helpful to us. If you think Time Calc Pro is worthy, would you mind taking a moment to write a nice review? We'd greatly appreciate it. Thanks for using Time Calc!

show_hn.title: Show HN: TimeCalc – A Simple and Accurate Time Calculator for iPhone/iPad/Mac

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

TimeCalc is a small utility I’ve been maintaining for years. I originally built it to help pilots log and calculate flight hours without the hassle of spreadsheets or clunky online tools.

Over time, it evolved into a simple and accurate time calculator that lets you add, subtract, and compare hours, minutes, and seconds — or even calculate the exact difference between two dates.

This new version was completely rebuilt for iOS 26 and macOS, with:
- A clean, native interface
- iCloud sync across devices
- No ads, no accounts, no third-party servers
- Accurate operations on hours, minutes, seconds, and dates

It’s designed to do one thing well: make time math fast and reliable.
Data stays in your iCloud account, and everything works offline.

I’d love feedback especially from anyone who’s built or used similar tools. Are there features or workflows you’d expect from a native time calculator that could make it better?

Thanks for checking it out.
App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/time-calc-time-calculator/id1279195300
